name: echo
description: Echo the provided text (harmless example CLI tool).

name: fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return the raw body (generic HTTP tool).

name: dangerous
description: Example destructive tool gated by devil_mode.

name: whois
description: WHOIS lookup for a domain/IP (passive recon; requires network in sandbox).

name: dig
description: DNS lookup for a domain (passive recon; requires network in sandbox).

name: http_request
description: Fetch an authorized URL (GET by default; POST when method/data provided). Scope-validated, non-destructive.

name: session_login
description: Submit the configured login form with authorized credentials and reuse the session. Credentials come from config, never from params.

name: form_discover
description: List the forms (action, method, fields) of an authorized URL.

name: http_header_probe
description: Return the security-relevant response headers of an authorized URL.
